first_open_node: OUTER: balanced unrestricted frame selection for arbitrary connected simple cubic graphs

statements.K33: The star chromatic index of K3,3 is exactly six. Hence its entire three-plus-two frame space has no balanced frame, although its unrestricted four-plus-two space does.
statements.ODD: Every finite simple cubic graph with a spanning factor whose cycle lengths belong to {3,5} has a star edge coloring with at most six colors.
statements.PRE: Every finite simple cubic graph has E=D disjoint-union U where U is a vertex-spanning disjoint union of one-edge and two-edge paths and D has a star edge coloring in {1,2,3,4}; the resulting full C19 signed phase graph has no self row.
statements.ROOT: For every finite simple undirected graph G with maximum degree at most 3, there exists a proper edge coloring c:E(G)->{1,2,3,4,5,6} with no bichromatic simple four-edge path or four-cycle.
statements.SQ: Every finite simple cubic graph with a spanning factor of four-cycles has a star edge coloring with at most five colors.
